name: Node.js Backend Development
description: Building server-side applications and REST APIs with Node.js and Express, including async I/O, middleware and data persistence.

questions.question: Which file lists a Node.js project's dependencies and npm scripts?
questions.explanation: package.json holds project metadata, dependencies and scripts; node_modules contains the installed packages.

questions.question: In Express, which method registers a handler for HTTP GET requests to /users?
questions.explanation: app.get(path, handler) registers a route handler for GET requests on that path.

questions.question: Why should you avoid long CPU-bound synchronous work (e.g. a huge loop) in a Node.js request handler?
options: It blocks the single-threaded event loop, delaying every other request
questions.explanation: JavaScript runs on one event loop thread; blocking it stalls all concurrent requests. Offload with worker threads or a separate service.

questions.question: What does calling next() inside an Express middleware do?
options: Sends a 200 response to the client
Passes control to the next matching middleware or route handler
questions.explanation: Middleware either ends the request-response cycle or calls next() to hand off; next(err) jumps to error-handling middleware.

questions.question: What is printed by: setTimeout(() => console.log('A'), 0); Promise.resolve().then(() => console.log('B')); console.log('C');
questions.explanation: Synchronous code runs first (C), then microtasks such as promise callbacks (B), then timer macrotasks (A).

questions.question: What is the safest way to build a SQL query using a user-supplied id in Node.js?
options: Concatenate the id into the query string after trimming whitespace
Use a parameterized query, e.g. db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1', [id])
Wrap the id in single quotes inside a template literal
Validate that the id is not empty and then interpolate it
questions.explanation: Parameterized queries send data separately from SQL code, preventing SQL injection.

practical.title: Create an Express POST endpoint
practical.instructions: Write an Express snippet that parses JSON request bodies and defines a POST /api/users route. If the body has no name, respond with status 400 and a JSON error; otherwise respond with status 201 and the created user as JSON.
practical.expected_output: app.use(express.json()); app.post('/api/users', (req, res) => { const { name } = req.body; if (!name) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'name is required' }); res.status(201).json({ id: 1, name }); });

rubric.hint: Add app.use(express.json()) so req.body is parsed.
Validate req.body.name and respond with res.status(400).json({ error: ... }).
Respond with res.status(201).json(user) for a created resource.

tasks.title: Learn Node.js fundamentals
tasks.description: Read the Node.js Learn guides on getting started, the event loop, modules and npm. Run each example locally.
tasks.completion_criteria: Can explain the event loop, CommonJS versus ES modules, and how npm scripts work.

tasks.title: Build a hello-world Express API
tasks.description: Install Express and create a server with GET and POST routes for an in-memory list of notes. Test the routes with curl or an API client.
tasks.completion_criteria: Server returns JSON for GET /notes and creates notes via POST /notes with correct status codes.

tasks.title: Add a database, validation and error handling
tasks.description: Persist the notes API in PostgreSQL or SQLite using parameterized queries. Add input validation, centralized error-handling middleware and environment-based configuration.
tasks.completion_criteria: Full CRUD API backed by a database, with validation errors returning 400 and unexpected errors handled by middleware.

tasks.title: Ship a production-ready REST API
tasks.description: Build an API with authentication, pagination, rate limiting, automated tests and logging. Containerize or deploy it and document the endpoints.
tasks.completion_criteria: Deployed API with auth, at least 10 passing integration tests and published endpoint documentation.
